name: Mam ruoi
summary: Mắm rươi is rươi tossed with salt, kept about ten days, sun-dried, and mixed with tangerine peel. It is a dip for herbs and boiled pork.
origin: Vinh. The city introduction sets it beside chả rươi and calls the cure simpler.
howToEat: Use it as a dip. The cure it does print is about 10 days, then sun, then tangerine peel.
where: A street was not printed. Check on arrival.
seoTitle: Mam ruoi in Vinh — salted sandworm
